Python CLI (op.py) read directly for SQL, file operations and logging. Test photos/logs under testing/ and the committed .claude/settings.local.json (Claude Code permission allowlist, no credentials) were noted but not treated as secrets. GitHub Actions YAML is out of scope for deep analysis in skill version 1.0.

pyproject project name is 'op' with placeholder description 'Add your description here'

databases.credential_source: none (local file .orgphoto_cache.db in the target directory)

sql_injection_risk.reason: all execute/executemany calls use ? placeholders; no string-built SQL found

file_system_access.detail: recursively reads user-supplied source directory (photos/videos) and copies or moves files (shutil.copy2 / shutil.move) into YYYY_MM_DD subdirectories of the destination; can delete/demote duplicates depending on mode
writes events.log in the destination directory and a SQLite hash cache .orgphoto_cache.db

sensitive_data_indicators.field_or_variable: EXIF metadata (creation dates, possibly GPS) read from user photos

what_this_app_can_do: Scans a chosen folder tree of photos and videos and copies or moves each file into date-named folders (YYYY_MM_DD) in a destination folder, using EXIF dates or file timestamps.
Detects duplicate files by SHA-256 hash and applies one of several handling modes, including selecting a master file and demoting others.
Maintains a local SQLite hash cache and an events.log file in the destination directory.

data_sources_touched.source: Local SQLite cache .orgphoto_cache.db and events.log in destination

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Command-line tool run locally by whoever invokes it; no network listener and no authentication, with the file-system permissions of the running user.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: Moves files from the source tree when the move option is used, which can alter original photo archives; no network or external data transfer found.

top_findings: No secrets, routes or external APIs found
SQLite cache uses parameterized queries (no injection path)
Tool moves/copies user files with the user's own file permissions
